occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: At the time of inspection a child was found in a room alone and unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of caregivers-Set appropriate behavior expectations: At the time of inspection the school age room was not in control, children were running around, horseplaying and did not have any planned activity they were engaged in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children: A caregiver was witnessed on video grabbing and infant in the crib by one arm and turning them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: At the time of inspection the caregivers were not following a written plan and the classroom was not in control.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A Caregiver failed to demonstrate self control when she was witnessed on video, frustrated with infants, and roughly shaking an infant, and roughly using her foot to shake an infant in a bouncer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children: A caregiver was observed on video grabbing an infant by the arm and leg while in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: An infant caregiver at the time of inspection did not have current SIDs, Shaken Baby training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: This standard was evaluated in regards to a report  and found deficient. The school age  room is not being properly  maintained ,this is evident by overflowing trash as well as unclean bathrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: This standard was evaluated in regard to a report and found deficient. The operation failed to report alleged allegations by a parent in a timely manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: All infants in care did not have current feeding instructions on file.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated in regards to a report and found deficient.
